Actor Zachary Levi tells Rogan, in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience, about the therapy he credits with saving his life. Levi, known for upbeat film and TV roles, speaks here about a private collapse that fans never saw. His honesty gives the segment its weight.

He describes hitting a breaking point, checking into intensive treatment, and the slow work of facing old wounds. Rogan asks what the therapy asked of him day by day. Levi's account speaks to anyone who looks fine in public and is not, and it shows the show at its most personal and plain-spoken.
